exam_scheme.note: Jammu and Kashmir Common Entrance Test (JKCET) is conducted by the J&K Board of Professional Entrance Examinations (JKBOPEE) for admissions into undergraduate Bachelor of Engineering & Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) degree programmes across government and private engineering colleges in Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.

stages.stage_name: JKCET Objective Entrance Examination (OMR-Based Single Paper)
stages.source_label: JKBOPEE Notification No. 050-BOPEE of 2026 (CET Engineering Exam Schedule) & Notification No. 044-BOPEE of 2026 (Admission Notification)

papers.paper_name: Composite Question Paper: Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics (180 Objective MCQs: 60 Physics, 60 Chemistry, 60 Mathematics)
papers.negative_marking: -0.25 per wrong answer (+1 mark per correct answer)

stages.stage_name: JKBOPEE Centralized Counseling & Institutional Seat Allotment
stages.source_label: JKBOPEE Notification No. 067-BOPEE of 2026 (1st Round Online Counselling) & Notification No. 072-BOPEE of 2026 (Provisional Selection List)

papers.paper_name: Online Choice Filling, Document Verification & Merit Seat Allocation (Allotment under J&K Reservation Rules S.O. 176 of 2024 / S.O. 305 across GCET Jammu, GCET Ganderbal, UIET Kathua, MIET, MBS, YCET, and SSM)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit rank based allocation subject to minimum 10+2 PCM qualifying marks (45% for Open Merit/EWS, 40% for Reserved Categories SC/ST/RBA/ALC/IB/OBC)

competition_benchmarks.note: Official appearance and provisional merit list candidate counts published by the Controller of Examinations, J&K Board of Professional Entrance Examinations (JKBOPEE).

years.selectivity_ratio: Statewide common entrance test for B.E./B.Tech engineering admissions in UT of J&K and Ladakh; exactly 1,263 candidates appeared and were ranked in the official Provisional Merit List (top score 177.50/180 by Dhananjay Pandit)
years.source_label: JKBOPEE Notification No. 056-BOPEE of 2026 Dated 06-05-2026: Provisional Merit List/Result of the Common Entrance Test for admission to B.E./B.Tech. Courses-2026 (Annexure A, 51 pages)

years.selectivity_ratio: Statewide entrance test conducted across Jammu, Srinagar, Doda, Rajouri, Anantnag, Baramulla, and Leh; exactly 1,445 candidates appeared and were ranked in the official Provisional Merit List (top score 148.00/180 by Rudra Kohli)
years.source_label: JKBOPEE Notification No. 040-BOPEE of 2025 Dated 24-04-2025: Provisional Merit List/Result for admission to B.E./B.Tech. Courses-2025 (Annexure A, 53 pages)

years.selectivity_ratio: Statewide entrance test held on June 9, 2024; exactly 1,662 candidates appeared and were ranked in the official Provisional Merit List (top score 112.75/180 by Krishna Arun Magotra)
years.source_label: JKBOPEE Notification No. 035-BOPEE of 2024 Dated 24-06-2024: Provisional Merit List/Result for admission to B.E./B.Tech. Courses-2024 (Annexure A, 46 pages)
